scope: 从已取得导出中选取可见用户/助手消息；不含内部推理、工具日志或授权码。不声称完整平台记录；保留来源顺序，文件之间可能重叠。子代理初始指令未必由导出接口返回；不能据助手回复条数推定实现调用次数。

messages.text: I’ll read the diff, calculate the finding floor, and check for missing behavior as well as defects.
The cancellation transaction looks cohesive. I’m now checking the browser’s response handling and the verification scripts, where a passing test may still leave an important failure path uncovered.

I reproduced several client-side gaps: an empty JSON response is reported as a definite rejection, missing numeric fields can still produce a success message, and a successful cancellation loses its confirmation if the following list refresh returns an expired-session response.

- Finding floor: 810,354 bytes ÷ 1,000 = 810.354 kB; N = min(floor(√810.354 + 1), 10) = min(29, 10) = **10**.

- [history.js:176](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:176): Verify the detail response ID before enabling cancellation. A response containing booking 105 for `/api/bookings/104` displays 105, but confirmation still posts to `/104/cancel`. I reproduced this with the existing handler harness. Reject mismatched details and keep cancellation unavailable.

- [history.js:139](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:139): Validate DTO fields before formatting them. Missing `attendees` or `room.capacity` becomes the string `"undefined 人"`, passes the new type check, overwrites the preserved details, and announces cancellation success. The incomplete-response test currently misses these partially incomplete objects.

- [history.js:205](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:205): Malformed envelopes are incorrectly treated as definite server rejections. HTTP 200 with `{}` displays “取消未完成” and “重试取消本预约,” although the cancellation outcome is unknown. Require a valid error envelope before setting `api: true`; otherwise use the unknown-result confirmation path.

- [history.js:70](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:70): Session expiry during cancellation focuses an empty element. `expired(error, cancelFeedback)` clears `cancelFeedback`, writes the login explanation elsewhere, then focuses the cleared paragraph. Focus the populated explanation or relogin link instead; the harness reproduces an active element with empty text.

- [history.js:217](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:217): Preserve the confirmed outcome when the subsequent list refresh returns `AUTH_REQUIRED`. Currently `expired()` removes every cancellation-success message, leaving only a login-expired message despite a successful cancellation. Clear protected data while retaining a generic confirmation that cancellation succeeded and refreshing requires login.

- [history.js:228](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:228): Restore keyboard focus when disabling the cancellation button caused focus to disappear. The current code preserves focus moved elsewhere, but leaves the ordinary keyboard submission path without a focused control after completion or failure. Conditionally restore a suitable destination when focus remains on the document body.

- [history.js:215](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/booking_app/static/history.js:215): Restore explicit empty-state feedback after automatic refresh. Cancelling the last pending booking while filtering by `pending` leaves an empty list with only “取消后预约列表已刷新.” Reuse the normal list feedback so users understand that no pending bookings remain and can change the filter.

- [verify_member_cancel_http.py:96](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_member_cancel_http.py:96): Preserve every concurrent outcome even when one worker raises. The first exceptional `future.result()` stops artifact collection, discarding later responses and the post-race storage snapshot precisely when investigation is needed. Record sanitized per-worker failures, drain all futures, save storage, then fail validation.

- [verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:81](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/scripts/verify_member_cancel_browser.cjs:81): Add the missing schedule-page DOM assertion. The runner checks availability through the page but verifies released schedule occupancy only through a direct API request. Exercise the room/date schedule controls and assert that the cancelled booking disappears from the rendered schedule.

- [test_history_browser_runner.py:31](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/tests/test_history_browser_runner.py:31): Add a deterministic regression for the new zombie-only `PermissionError` recovery branch. Fast-exit repetitions do not guarantee that branch executes, especially on Linux; the mocked tests cover only rejection paths. Inject `PermissionError` with a successful zombie-only process listing and assert cleanup succeeds.
